text: Reproduced a false sensed success on development seed 1000. All 150 hold samples have hand-only contact, but minimum complete clearance is 0.0942534537 m. The tool succeeds because it uses centre displacement. Hypothesis: use the observed orientation and enclosing object geometry for a conservative lower surface bound, and control lift toward clearance above the table. Keep the 0.10 m / 3 s evaluator gate. A regression test was added first and currently fails because the observation helper is absent. This is a general algorithmic correction.
